# boidboard perft oracle -- published node counts for the six standard perft positions.
#
# This file is DATA, not code. It is the external oracle against which boidboard's move
# generator is judged in issue #6. It was authored before any engine code existed, which
# is the entire point of it: the criteria precede the implementation.
#
# PROVENANCE
#   requested-url:      https://www.chessprogramming.org/Perft_Results
#   source-url:         https://chessprogramming.org/Perft_Results  (HTTP 301 from the above
#                       on GET; a HEAD request answers 308)
#   fetched:            2026-08-16
#   http-status:        200
#   page-bytes:         33664
#   page-sha256:        8c6ba8849553f39be1edf5182d5cd10618b90ae7d28a85c41bfff53d17e36741
#   page-last-modified: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 21:11:17 GMT
#   page-licence:       CC BY-SA 3.0, Chess Programming Wiki contributors
#   page-note:          served from a read-only recovery mirror of the wiki; no MediaWiki
#                       oldid permalink was available, hence the content hash above.
#   corroborated-with:  Stockfish 16 (Ubuntu package 16-1build1, noble/universe),
#                       binary sha256
#                       00628bd9c9855c1b7ff93d7f8d51b413586cdc6336fe637f9a14a61531a05aca
#
# GRAMMAR (ASCII only; no tabs; ' | ' field separator; '#' begins a comment line)
#   id | fen | depth:nodes<flag> [depth:nodes<flag> ...]
#     id     [a-z0-9-]+, unique within the file
#     fen    as published, with U+00A0 separators normalised to U+0020 and trailing
#            whitespace stripped. The FIELD COUNT is preserved -- see the kiwipete note.
#     depth  decimal, ascending, contiguous, no duplicates
#     nodes  decimal digits only, no thousands separators, must fit in u64
#     flag   v = independently re-derived with Stockfish 16 by this project, 2026-08-16
#            p = published only; NOT corroborated here. Either too deep to replay in
#                reasonable time, or depth 0 -- which is 1 by definition and which
#                `go perft 0` cannot report, since it falls through to a real search.
#
#   Totals: 55 counts, of which 44 are 'v' and 11 are 'p'.
#
# DEPTH BUDGET
#   The differential harness replays every 'v' count whose value is <= the environment
#   variable BOID_PERFT_MAX_NODES (default 5000000). 'p' counts are documentation and are
#   never replayed. Budgeting by NODE COUNT rather than by depth keeps the policy correct
#   as positions are added: position3 depth 5 is 674624 nodes while kiwipete depth 4 is
#   4085603, so a depth cutoff would either waste cheap coverage or blow the budget.
#
# NORMALISATION (see docs/DECISIONS.md D-0008)
#   Six of the seven FENs are published with U+00A0 NON-BREAKING SPACE separators. They are
#   normalised to U+0020 here. This is a declared change, not verbatim storage, because
#   Stockfish's tokeniser is ASCII-only and silently mis-parses an NBSP-separated FEN into a
#   different legal position reporting "Nodes searched: 0", while Rust's split_whitespace
#   accepts it -- a silent wrong-answer path that would surface in issue #6 as a phantom
#   move-generation bug.
#
# NOT COMMITTED AS DATA
#   These published values exceed u64::MAX (18446744073709551615) and the wiki sources
#   them from forum estimate threads rather than exhaustive computation:
#     startpos depth 14 = 61885021521585529237
#     startpos depth 15 = 2015099950053364471960
#
# NOTE (kiwipete)
#   Published with FOUR FEN fields -- no halfmove or fullmove counters. Stored that way.
#   Do NOT append " 0 1". Stockfish accepts the four-field form; perft 3 = 97862.
#
# NOTE (position4-mirror)
#   The colour-mirror the wiki publishes alongside position4. Its counts are identical to
#   position4 at EVERY depth by construction, so no count-based test can tell the two rows
#   apart -- only byte-identity of the FEN strings can. Both are committed for exactly that
#   reason, and a test asserts the FENs differ while the count vectors match.
#
